svg.text: shinchan_shapes_offset.aesl: pen 4.5 cm straight behind the centre hole
Blue: what the pen draws on the calibrated robot. Grey: robot at the start, facing up, with the pen 4.5 cm straight behind the centre hole. Dotted: path of the robot's centre.
Pale box: paper needed so the wheels stay on it (robot body sweep + 2 cm). The pen starts at the red dot, robot facing up.
paper 27 × 28 cm; pen start 9 cm from the left, 14 cm from the bottom
